title: Yone Dual Blades
description: SlashBlade - affiliated Mod: Bringing Yone's dual - sword combat style from League of Legends into Minecraft!
body:
[VIDEO](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1M5M869E8m/) ## 📖 1. Mod Overview This is an add-on for SlashBlade, restoring Yone's dual-sword combat system from League of Legends. It contains two exclusive blades, dual-wield combos, unique Secret Arts, complete Chinese voice packs, execute mechanics and phantom sword locking teleport. ### Weapon Stats #### Sealed Demon Sword · Azure Gale (Wind) - ATK: 10 | Durability: 200 | Aura Color: Green - Crit: 15% chance, +50% crit damage - Exclusive SA: Wind Shadow Thousand Phantoms - Trait: All damage converted to armor-piercing magic damage, wind passive buffs #### Misfortune Cleaver · Ember Ruin (Fire) - ATK: 10 | Durability: 180 | Aura Color: Red - Crit: 20% chance, +75% crit damage - Exclusive SA: Evil Incinerating Slash - Trait: Pure physical damage, ignites enemies on hit --- ## ⚔️ 2. Dual-Wield Rules Condition: Hold Azure Gale and Ember Ruin in separate hands - Damage ×0.5 | Lifesteal 10% of dealt damage - Crit Rate ×1.5 | Crit Damage ×0.5 - Permanent Buffs: Speed II, Resistance I, Fire Immunity, No Fall Damage, clear Wither/Darkness - Visual: Dual red-green aura, basic attacks bypass mob iframes - Combat: Unlock 6-stage combo chain - Ultimate: Press R to cast Twin Sword Annihilation (execute low HP targets) --- ## 🎮 3. Key Controls | Shortcut | Function | |---------|---------| | R | Single-hand: Instant full-charge SA
Dual-wield: Cast Twin Sword Annihilation | | Z | Cast mainhand Secret Art | | X | Cast offhand Secret Art | | Shift | Tap once to lock target, tap again to unlock | | Forward + Sprint + Sneak | Phantom Sword Teleport
(Only works on airborne locked targets; jump upward for ground enemies) | --- ## ✨ 4. Secret Arts (SA) ### Wind Shadow Thousand Phantoms (Azure Gale Only) Dash forward, knock up & slow nearby targets. Execute enemies below 5% HP. Base CD: 5s, reduced by attack speed (minimum 1s). ### Evil Incinerating Slash (Ember Ruin Only) 120° wide fan slash, mixed % max HP damage. Gain temporary HP on hit, apply Ignite + Poison. ### Twin Sword Annihilation (Dual-Wield Exclusive) 2-stage cross slash → gather enemies → teleport behind targets. Execute enemies below 10% HP, apply Ignite/Poison/Wither/Stun/Float. Fixed cooldown: 10s. --- ## 🔨 5. Crafting Recipes - **Wind Shard**: Feather + Phantom Membrane + Diamond Combine with Nameless Blade to craft Azure Gale - **Ember Core**: Blaze Powder + Magma Cream + Diamond Combine with Nameless Blade to craft Ember Ruin --- ## 🗣️ 6. Voice System Full Chinese voice lines for attack, SA, movement & death. Independent audio channel to avoid sound overlap. Disabled by default; enable & adjust volume in config. --- ## ⚙️ 7. Configuration File Path: `config/slashbladeyone-common.toml` Tunable options: - Global perfect SA release for all swords - Enable Twin Sword Annihilation for all dual-wield SlashBlades - SA cooldowns, dash movement speed - Voice toggle & volume multiplier
